title: Choir and Bell
author: Marguerite Joubert
blurb: Odile Iversen, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
